# LZMA SDK 26.03 — C# decoder subset

Upstream author: Igor Pavlov.

Source: https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.03/lzma2603.7z

Source archive SHA-256: `86c213f752520ab5325c310f50bef63ec344b56dd1c80b0246d06dc6cec953b2`.

These seven source files are copied without modification from `CS/7zip` of the official SDK. They implement only the LZMA decoder used for the embedded payload. The original SDK documentation and public-domain declaration are retained in `lzma-sdk.txt`.

The LZMA SDK is written and placed in the public domain by Igor Pavlov. This statement applies to the SDK subset here, not all code in the separate 7-Zip application.
